output.question: What is Tonix Pharmaceuticals' short interest?
output.answer: The latest figure I could find is for October 30, 2026, the most recent FINRA settlement date. Short interest in Tonix Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: TNXP) was 3,318,461 shares, about 19.42% of its float of roughly 17.09 million shares, with 4.14 days to cover. That is up 377,753 shares (+12.85%) from October 15, 2026, when 2,940,708 shares were short (17.21% of float, 2.41 days to cover). StockAnalysis, which may not have the October 30 data yet, still shows 2.94 million shares short (15.13% of shares outstanding, 16.14% of float, 3.48 days to cover).

passages.quote: As of 2026-10-30, there were 3,318,461 shares short with a short interest of 19.42%.
The latest short interest is 2.94 million, so 15.13% of the outstanding shares have been sold short.

caveats: The sources work out percentages differently: ChartExchange uses the float of about 17.09M shares, while StockAnalysis's 15.13% and 16.14% figures imply a different share count. Their percentages for the same number of shares short therefore don't match.
StockAnalysis appears to show the Oct 15 figure (2.94M), not the newer Oct 30 data.
FINRA publishes short interest twice a month. The next settlement date (mid-November 2026) will replace these figures.
I did not open FINRA or Nasdaq's own short-interest pages. These figures come from third-party aggregators that use FINRA data.
